public_sources: arXiv:2607.10878v1 LOGOS: A Living Logic for AI Agent Teams That Evolve With Humans
Fujitsu public technology page: 2026-07 Multi AI Agent Framework

actions: Verified the LOGOS primary-paper self-evolution protocol against the sequence-89 four-surface frontier.

Bound proposal/selection/final-gate/report roles, candidate-local anytime-valid e-process assumptions, LORD-style cross-candidate accounting, and gate-feedback exposure budgeting to a machine-readable role-local contract.
Searched public GitHub/author/Fujitsu surfaces for an executable LOGOS/MAAF implementation; none was identified in this run.
Persisted sequence-90 checkpoint and advanced the role-local LATEST pointer with CAS/readback discipline.

result.finding: LOGOS explicitly specifies proposal EXPLORE, optional separate candidate-selection TUNE, disjoint frozen final-gate CERTIFY with candidate-local anytime-valid evidence, and a third report holdout outside proposal/selection/adoption. It additionally specifies LORD-style cross-candidate accounting and a budgeted gate-feedback channel. Public executable evidence remains unbound.

blockers_and_limits: No public source-bound LOGOS/MAAF implementation was found, so crash-safe evaluation consumption and durable online-spending state are not executable-verified.
The paper excludes report holdout use for proposal, selection and adoption, but zero use by rollback, routing, stopping and recovery is not source-code verified.
Empirical zero-regression mechanism checks include conservative full-rejection regimes and must not be generalized to high adoption power.
exact_next_action: Search for a public executable implementation of LOGOS/MAAF or an equivalent four-surface self-improvement system. Require frozen candidate/selection state before CERTIFY, actual anytime-valid certification under the implemented sampler, restart-durable cross-candidate statistical state without refund/reset, zero pre-terminal OUTER queries with no use by promotion/rollback/routing/stopping/recovery, and immutable candidate identities plus complete proposal/evaluation chronology.
